snippet.title: Mario Tennis Fever – Nintendo Direct 9.12.2025
snippet.description:
Mario Tennis Fever is coming to Nintendo Switch 2 on Feb 12, 2026. Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/mario-tennis-fever-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=A1013-01&utm_id=A1013-01

Grab your Fever Racket and get ready to hit the court when the latest entry in the Mario Tennis series swings onto Nintendo Switch 2.

Try out 30 different Fever Rackets, each with their own special ability, and take your pick from 38 playable characters!

#MarioTennisFever #NintendoSwitch2 #NintendoDirect

Visit Nintendo.com for more info: https://ninten.do/6008Spp2s
